hero.subheadline: Expand beyond the physical counter with connected ordering channels that support modern retail growth.

about.title_html: Manage Every Online Order in One Place
about.text_html: Delivery and online ordering have moved from 'nice to have' to must have for liquor and neighborhood stores. Retailers on delivery platforms are unlocking new revenue without increasing overhead. Store owners report struggling with delivery orders on separate tablets, manual POS reconciliation, and no single view of all incoming orders. That's exactly what A2Z POS was designed for.

features.title: Delivery App Integration
features.description: Connect to major platforms like Uber Eats, DoorDash, and Grubhub. All incoming delivery orders route to one screen, not separate tablets.
